text: Started base64 markdown export card. Found the existing download at braindump.js downloadMarkdownNode (line ~7522): it already zips repo-local image refs. Need to add base64 reference-style mode, markdown-only mode, a mode prompt, and a board settings default of 'ask'.

Three markdown download modes working in a real page: base64 (single .md, ![alt][label] at the point of use, [label]: data:image/png;base64,... at the bottom, decoded bytes byte-identical to the served PNG), zip (unchanged), markdown-only. Prompt on the download arrow, setting in the panel, shipped default 'ask'. 24/24 cases pass on the patched mirror; the suite dies at the missing prompt without the patch.

Done. patch.json has 10 hunks, all anchors verified unique on disk: 9 in braindump.js plus one collateral fix in theme-and-light-mode.test.mjs, whose case F grabs the settings panel's only <select> by element name and now finds two. Threshold for 'small enough' is 512 KB per asset; anything over keeps its path and the toast names it. Static-host probe passes with every /api/* route refused. Regressions green including all 72 caret probes and both export suites.
